test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A train 180 m long passes a point in 12 s. Its speed is?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Speed = Distance ÷ Time Distance = Length of train = 180 m Speed in m/s = 180 ÷ 12 = 15 m/s Speed in km/h = 15 × (18/5) = 54 km/h **∴ The correct answer is 54 km/h.**
